81166baa0efff72c.text: This instrument has been designed to be used for brushing the suction channels of OES TRANSDUODENAL CHOLEDOCHOFIBERSCOPE CHF-B20 and BRONCHOFIBERVIDEOSCOPE BF-MP190F/290F *1 . Do not use this product for any purpose other than its intended use.

f412628e5a2daf31.text: Indicates a potentially hazardous situation which, if not avoided, could result in death or serious injury.

362f859dc7a7b6c3.text: • Before and after use, visually inspect the exterior of the Channel Cleaning Brush for breakage etc. In particular, confirm that Metal Tip is firmly attached. Using a damaged or worn brush may damage the endoscope being cleaned.
lists: Before and after use, visually inspect the exterior of the Channel Cleaning Brush for breakage etc. In particular, confirm that Metal Tip is firmly attached. Using a damaged or worn brush may damage the endoscope being cleaned.

42bd22dbc1ab9ed0.text: • The Channel Cleaning Brush is a consumable item. The bristle section can be damaged, by, for example, bending or buckling. If the bristle section becomes detached and remains inside the channel, insert (for example) biopsy forceps to retrieve it. Depending on the location, the bristle section may not be recoverable. In this case, contact Olympus. If the bristle section is left unrecovered within the scope, and the scope is used in this condition, the unrecovered portion may become dislodged from the scope during the patient procedure.

154f8e0a21a784d9.text: • To avoid splattering of detergent solution when the Channel Cleaning Brush is pulled out, keep the endoscope away from your face.
lists: To avoid splattering of detergent solution when the Channel Cleaning Brush is pulled out, keep the endoscope away from your face.

288ba8736a9a21af.text: Before brushing, read the instruction manual for the compatible endoscope being cleaned thoroughly and perform the necessary preparation and inspection. Then, use the Channel Cleaning Brush according to the instruction manual for the compatible endoscope. 6 REPROCESSING

44452407061c40b0.text: • Patient debris and reprocessing chemicals are hazardous. Wear protective equipment.
lists: Patient debris and reprocessing chemicals are hazardous. Wear protective equipment.

a358ce551544d105.text: • With the cleaning, disinfection and sterilization methods stated in this instruction manual, prions, which are considered to be the pathogenic substance of the Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD) cannot be destroyed or inactivated. When using this instrument on a patient with CJD or variant Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (vCJD), be sure to use this product for such patient only and/or immediately dispose of this product after use in an appropriate manner. For methods to handle CJD, please follow the respective guidelines in your country.

For methods to handle CJD, please follow the respective guidelines in your country.

c5cb5dfcaf704910.text: • This instrument is not durable, or does not have sufficient durability against the respective methods stated in the guidelines of each country for destroying or inactivating prions. For information on the durability against each method, please contact Olympus. If cleaning, disinfection and sterilization methods not stated in this instruction manual are performed, Olympus cannot guarantee the effectiveness, safety and durability of this instrument. Make sure to confirm that there is no abnormality before use, and use under responsibility of a physician. Do not use if any abnormality is found.

38a5ba0190b3edfb.text: When performing ultrasonic cleaning, disinfection or sterilization, do not coil the shaft with a diameter less than 15 cm. The shaft can be damaged if coiled too tightly.

677f353125d83a75.text: 1. Soak the Channel Cleaning Brush in a low foaming detergent solution for the amount of time and at the temperature recommended by the detergent manufacturer.
lists: Soak the Channel Cleaning Brush in a low foaming detergent solution for the amount of time and at the temperature recommended by the detergent manufacturer.

2bb0740a08a64918.text: 2. Clean the entire brush, while it is soaking in the low foaming detergent solution, using a sponge or lint-free cloth. In particular, clean off the bristle section with your fingertips to remove adhering debris.
lists: Clean the entire brush, while it is soaking in the low foaming detergent solution, using a sponge or lint-free cloth. In particular, clean off the bristle section with your fingertips to remove adhering debris.

0e1c9bc6af130ccc.text: 3. Rinse with water to remove the detergent solution completely.
lists: Rinse with water to remove the detergent solution completely.

e35ae8fdc8c2f444.text: 4. Perform ultrasonic cleaning, for 5 minutes at 38 – 47 KHz.
lists: Perform ultrasonic cleaning, for 5 minutes at 38 – 47 KHz.

f27e0fe0e28242aa.text: 5. Rinse in water, then thoroughly dry with lint-free cloth.
lists: Rinse in water, then thoroughly dry with lint-free cloth.

f870991716c13ab2.text: If the brush is not thoroughly cleaned, residual organic debris may solidify and it may be difficult to effectively disinfect or sterilize the brush.

3ce4635661317f2d.text: 1. After cleaning the brush in accordance with Section 6.1, “Cleaning” prepare a 2.0 – 3.2% glutaraldehyde solution. Follow the manufacturer’s instructions regarding its concentration and temperature.
lists: After cleaning the brush in accordance with Section 6.1, “Cleaning” prepare a 2.0 – 3.2% glutaraldehyde solution. Follow the manufacturer’s instructions regarding its concentration and temperature.

f60491d80f58763f.text: 2. Soak the Channel Cleaning Brush in a basin filled with disinfectant solution, then remove bubbles from the outer surface, using a lint-free cloth. In particular, rub the bristle section with your fingers to remove bubbles.
lists: Soak the Channel Cleaning Brush in a basin filled with disinfectant solution, then remove bubbles from the outer surface, using a lint-free cloth. In particular, rub the bristle section with your fingers to remove bubbles.

6dd4bebad2cbb74a.text: 3. Soak in disinfectant solution for the amount of time recommended by the disinfectant manufacturer.
lists: Soak in disinfectant solution for the amount of time recommended by the disinfectant manufacturer.

2f4062dbe4373231.text: 4. Remove from the disinfectant solution, then rinse thoroughly with sterile water.
lists: Remove from the disinfectant solution, then rinse thoroughly with sterile water.

ae47bfb482304de3.text: 5. Thoroughly dry with a sterile lint-free cloth.
lists: Thoroughly dry with a sterile lint-free cloth.

f348c6f2266ceb76.text: Contact Olympus for the names of specific disinfectants with which the Channel Cleaning Brush is compatible.

1e986fb8d495d977.text: 1. After cleaning the brush in accordance with Section 6.1, “Cleaning”, seal the brush in packaging appropriate for steam (autoclave) sterilization according to your hospital’s protocol.
lists: After cleaning the brush in accordance with Section 6.1, “Cleaning”, seal the brush in packaging appropriate for steam (autoclave) sterilization according to your hospital’s protocol.

00fcca6b5d44085f.text: 2. Autoclave the brush (steam sterilization) under the following conditions. Operate the autoclave in accordance with its instruction manual.
lists: Autoclave the brush (steam sterilization) under the following conditions. Operate the autoclave in accordance with its instruction manual.

3a643e81757c5e07.text: 3. Utilize the autoclave drying cycle, or leave the brush in the autoclave at the conclusion of the cycle with the door ajar, to ensure that the sterile packs are dry before handling.
lists: Utilize the autoclave drying cycle, or leave the brush in the autoclave at the conclusion of the cycle with the door ajar, to ensure that the sterile packs are dry before handling.

56836b7108424c98.text: When autoclaving, make sure that the bristles are not crushed flat. 7 STORAGE

c56b5fc850ad7362.text: Store the Channel Cleaning Brush at a room temperature, in a dry, clean location away from direct sunlight.

2b8f062eb3e9a869.text: • Do not coil the shaft with a diameter less than 15 cm. The shaft can be damaged if coiled too tightly.
lists: Do not coil the shaft with a diameter less than 15 cm. The shaft can be damaged if coiled too tightly.

safety_blocks.text: 低泡性洗浄液にチャンネル掃除用ブラシを浸漬します。洗浄液の温度、浸漬時間については洗浄液の取扱説明書 に従ってください。

safety_blocks.text: 低泡性洗浄液中で、スポンジまたはガーゼを用いて全体を洗浄します。特にブラシ部に付着した血液などは指で つまみ洗いし十分に洗浄除去します。
